Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by br0sBeastRacesOfSkyrimCompilationV3 (br0sBeastRacesOfSkyrimCompilationV3.esp).

Install this if br0sBeastRacesOfSkyrimCompilationV3.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
